default.notes: Not on the tourist eVisa list — visas are issued through Saudi embassies, most commonly for work, family visit or Umrah. Holders of a valid, previously used US, UK or Schengen visa may qualify for a visa on arrival — confirm before travelling.

groups.notes: GCC citizens may enter Saudi Arabia freely under Gulf Cooperation Council arrangements — a national ID card is accepted and no visa is needed.
Eligible for the one-year multiple-entry tourist eVisa (stays up to 90 days); a visa on arrival is also available at major airports for a similar fee.

SA.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Saudi citizens.

IL.notes: Saudi Arabia does not admit travellers on Israeli passports — there are no diplomatic relations and Israeli documents are not accepted for entry.
